task: Partial-identification ranking of six foodborne pathogen groups by the standardized hospitalization proportion among reported outbreak cases (CDC NORS 2009-2023)
dataset: CDC National Outbreak Reporting System (NORS) public dataset, data.cdc.gov id 5xkq-dg7x, snapshot 2026-11-25 (portal rows updated 2024-12-20)

metric_definitions.L_worst_case: standardized lower bound, all unrecorded-status cases not hospitalized
metric_definitions.U_worst_case: standardized upper bound, all unrecorded-status cases hospitalized
metric_definitions.theta_delta0: standardized proportion if unrecorded-status cases had the recorded rate (delta = 0)
metric_definitions.L_delta5 / U_delta5: bounds if the unrecorded-status rate is within 5 percentage points of the recorded rate

statistics.note: Sample bounds are deterministic identification intervals; sampling uncertainty is quantified by stratified outbreak-level bootstrap, state-clustered M-estimation sandwich covariances, Imbens-Manski 95% CIs, and Max-T FWER tests.

provenance.source: measured: code/analyze.py on the audited cohort built by code/prepare_data.py from the CDC NORS snapshot

R1a_crude_all.label: Crude: no standardization, all eligible outbreaks

R1b_crude_support.label: Crude within the common support (no standardization)

R3b_complete_only.label: Cohort: records with any blank H or K dropped

R4a_threshold_2.label: Common support ≥ 2 outbreaks per group per cell

R4b_threshold_5.label: Common support ≥ 5 outbreaks per group per cell

R5_named_settings.label: Drop Unknown and Multiple setting cells

R10_outbreak_weighted.label: Within-cell aggregation: equal weight per outbreak

bootstrap.scheme: resample outbreaks with replacement within group x common-support cell; cells fixed; pooled-case weights recomputed per replicate

handling: excluded: outcome not attributable to one study group (counted)
kept: H=0 implied by H<=K; all C unknown
kept: H in [0,K] not identified; all C treated as unknown (bounds 0..1)

main.description: main eligibility (one confirmed study group, genus level, single or same-group multi-entry); keep every record with a valid bound (weaker constraint where a field is missing)

single_etiology.description: single-etiology Confirmed outbreaks only (the step's original default); main audit rule

complete_only.description: main eligibility; keep only complete_consistent records (any missing H or K excluded)

pilot_rule.description: pilot exact species strings, single etiology, Confirmed; exclude records with exactly one of H/K missing, keep both-missing as all-unknown (reproduces the pilot's 3,799 / 96 / 3,703)

pilot_reproduction.eligibility_rule: pilot exact species strings, single etiology

pilot.note: Pilot figures come from earlier exploratory checks and are retained to document cohort convergence.

small_sample_calibration.design: bootstrap-world stratified resample preserving observed stratum counts n_js

notes: All numbers are recomputed from the 2026-11-25 snapshot. 'undetermined' means the recorded data do not fix the direction; it does not mean equal. delta is a scenario parameter, not an estimate.
estimates_note: Point-wise identification bounds appear in `main`; uniformly valid Imbens-Manski 95% CIs, outbreak-HC1/state-clustered Max-T FWER p-values, and rank confidence sets appear in `stacked_inference`.
